Gujarat High Court Directs State on Haren Pandya Murder Convict's Remission Plea

The Gujarat High Court has directed the state government to make a decision regarding the remission plea of Mohammad Ashgar Ali, a convict in the Haren Pandya murder case. Ali had approached the High Court, stating that the government had not acted on his application for remission, which he submitted in 2025 after completing 14 years of imprisonment. The court has given the state six months to decide on the plea.
